items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I never knew him. I knew Bill Matthews as the only brother I knew.

ctx.x: But they was calling him Tyke. His nickname, they called him Tyke.
Yeah, I never knew him. I knew Bill Matthews as the only brother I knew.
Well, they had four of them, and all of them was drummers.
